LanguageData.CC_Settings_BreweryInKitchen: Breweries work in the kitchen too
LanguageData.CC_Settings_BreweryInKitchen_Tip: The game names one room for each workbench and slows it to 80% anywhere else: the brewery's room is the workshop. Brewing is cooking work, done by your cooks, so with this on a brewery (and any other workshop bench whose work is all cooking) works at full speed in a kitchen as well. Beside a stove it counts toward the kitchen, not the workshop, so it never turns your kitchen into a workshop and slows the stoves. Off, the game's own rule.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_BreweryInKitchen: A brewery works at full speed in the kitchen as well as the workshop.
